maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from newspaper subscriptions and local advertising and digital marketing, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by local advertisers and subscribing readers, which are private businesses and consumers, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Owns local newspapers across 72 markets but is mainly shrinking or realigning its portfolio, not growing through regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers can easily shift spend to other media, and readers can easily drop subscriptions. Both have low switching costs.
